decisions.reason: LHD loaders are core to the firm's underground mining expertise and have long sales cycles, but the earlier withdrawal of the companion dump trucks and the lack of website visibility since 2018 add some risk.
A construction site dumper fits the firm's construction and transport portfolio, though it faces strong competition from established dumper makers, so it is kept with moderate risk.
Inclined furniture lifts are a niche product line with its own dedicated presentation, low ongoing costs and a steady service-based demand, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Inclined building material lifts complement the furniture lifts, share the same technology and serve construction customers, so keeping them is sensible.
The truck-mounted variant extends the lift family with modest extra effort, though as a single, more specialized model it carries slightly higher risk.
